text:
maya: Hey team — opening a quick thread to coordinate a tiny "cheatsheet" addition to the private/VPC installer docs. PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5342. I want a single page with small, copy-paste snippets for networking + KMS/HSM preflight checks for air-gapped installs.

alan: Looking. Main things we should cover: ip forward, NAT/masquerade for pods, MTU/jumbo frames note for 10Gb, and a tiny nftables fallback for customers using nft instead of iptables.

tim: Also call out the HSM PKCS#11 path and a small systemd drop-in example to ensure the HSM daemon starts before installer. We get this wrong a lot in support tickets.

sofia: I can draft the netplan + iptables snippet. Quick ask — do we want both iptables-legacy and nft translation? I can add an `nft` example and a one-liner to translate rules with `iptables-translate`/`nft -f -`.

maya: Yes include both. Keep everything minimal — one-liner checks, one-liner fixes. Example checklist at top.

docs-bot: CI comment: linkcheck failed on /docs/private/install/cheatsheet.md — relative link to /docs/kms/hsm-config.md is broken in current branch.

alan: I'll fix the path in the PR, thanks bot.

tim: Draft snippets I propose (feel free to shorten):
```
# Enable IP forwarding
sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
# Persist
echo "net.ipv4.ip_forward=1" | sudo tee -a /etc/sysctl.d/99-redwood.conf

# Basic NAT for private CIDR (example)
sudo iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s 10.10.0.0/16 -j MASQUERADE

# nft equivalent (simple NAT table)
sudo nft add table ip redwood_nat || true
sudo nft 'add chain ip redwood_nat postroute { type nat hook postrouting priority 100 ; }'
sudo nft add rule ip redwood_nat postroute ip saddr 10.10.0.0/16 counter masquerade

# MTU note for 10Gb: set 9000 on kube host interfaces
sudo ip link set dev eth0 mtu 9000
```

sofia: For HSM/KMS: small PKCS11 path + systemd snippet:
```
# Expected PKCS11 lib path (example)
PKCS11_LIB=/usr/lib/libpkcs11-redwood.so

# systemd unit drop-in to start hsm-agent early
sudo mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/hsm-agent.service.d/
cat <<'EOF' | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/hsm-agent.service.d/10-wait-for-hw.conf
[Unit]
After=local-fs.target
Wants=local-fs.target
EOF
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
```

eng-sre: Two asks: (1) include `ss -4 -lntu` and `ip -4 route` as quick checks so they can validate listening sockets and routes; (2) for customers with NAT on the edge, include the iptables `--wait` flag for scripts (to avoid lock contention).

maya: Good call. Add that to the checklist. Also add small `preflight.sh` they can run offline: sha256 checks for bundles + connectivity probes (no external internet required).

tim: Proposed preflight snippet:
```
#!/bin/bash
set -e
# check bundles
sha256sum -c /opt/redwood/bundles/manifest.sha256
# local socket checks
ss -4 -lntu || true
ip -4 route || true
# check PKCS11 exists
[ -f "$PKCS11_LIB" ] || { echo "PKCS11 lib missing: $PKCS11_LIB"; exit 2; }
```

sofia: I'm going to push a small commit with the netplan example for Ubuntu 22.04 and the tiny nft/iptables examples. I'll also add a short paragraph explaining why MTU matters (fragmentation + cloud tunnel overhead).

alan: I'll update the PR to fix the linkcheck failure and add the docs-bot suggestion about the broken path.

maya: Can eng-sre + tim skim for accuracy? If you both give a quick :+1: I'll merge and squash into the main installer guide. We want this to be copy-paste friendly for support to point customers at.

eng-sre: Skimming now. One nit: for iptables we should recommend `iptables-save > /etc/iptables/rules.v4` on Debian variants and include the `-w` flag in example (so: `sudo iptables -w -t nat -A POSTROUTING ...`). Also mention `nftables` users might need the `nft` package installed in offline bundle.

tim: +1 for systemd drop-in, and add a short HSM troubleshooting tip: run `strace -e open /usr/sbin/hsm-agent` if device nodes  don't appear. I'll drop that as a one-liner in the HSM section.

maya: Perfect. Sofia — tag me when the commit is pushed and I'll do a final pass on voice/formatting.

sofia: Pushed `docs: add private install networking & hsm cheatsheet` -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/9f3a2b7. Updated PR #5342.

docs-bot: PR #5342 — linkcheck now passed. CI: green for linkcheck, md-lint warning for long line in preflight snippet.

maya: Great — can we wrap lines at 100 chars and use fenced blocks for all code? I'll merge after that small fix.

alan: I'll handle the md-lint wrap and rebase.

tim: Quick follow-up: add a one-sentence reminder to engineering-runbooks: "If using HSM in air-gapped mode, validate device node permissions and SELinux context before starting installer."

maya: Done. Thanks everyone. I'll merge once alan rebases. Closing thread after merge.
